details: Contradicted by singletons: the default ($\mathbb F_2$) Yang dimension is $n-1$, while co-VC dimension is $n$.
proof: On the singleton (delta-function) class, the recorded default Yang dimension is $n-1$, while co-VC dimension equals n. Thus $\mathrm Y(\mathcal H)<\operatorname{coVC}(\mathcal H)$ on this family, refuting the displayed universal inequality.
name: Yang dimension / co-VC dimension
